applicable_perils: Collision with vehicle or stationary object
Comprehensive: Fire, theft, vandalism, glass breakage, animal impact
specific_exclusions: Normal wear, tear, and gradual mechanical deterioration
Damage occurring during unauthorized commercial rideshare/courier use
Unlicensed operator at time of incident

clauses.content: The insurer will pay for sudden, accidental direct physical loss to the insured vehicle caused by collision with another vehicle or object, subject to the applicable $500 collision deductible. Labor rates are reimbursed up to regional prevailing standard ($65.00/hr body, $85.00/hr mechanical).

clauses.section_title: Replacement Parts Standard (OEM vs CAPA Certified)
clauses.content: For vehicles exceeding 3 model years from manufacture, replacement body panels, bumpers, and non-structural components will be priced at CAPA-certified aftermarket or OEM-reconditioned standard unless an OEM-only rider is active.
The insured collision deductible of $500 is applied once per loss incident and subtracted directly from the gross approved repair amount.
Loss or damage existing prior to the reported incident date, rusted components, worn brake pads, and cosmetic rust degradation are expressly excluded from claim settlement.
Any claim containing materially falsified timestamps, staged collisions, or manipulated photographic evidence will be denied and referred to the State Insurance Fraud Bureau.
